summary: ESO-55 (US-ARCH-03: Q2 Column Impact) implementation strictly satisfies all acceptance criteria (AC-ARCH-03-01 through AC-ARCH-03-05) and architectural invariants (INV-GR-01, INV-GR-02, INV-GR-03, BR-05). Traversal enforces reverse-dependency order (table -> entity -> dto -> app_service) with 0 forward relations, strictly validates relations against ALLOWED_RELATIONS_Q2 without fabrication, computes question completeness against threshold/floor refusing when coverage is sub-floor or missing, reports status 'unknown' with LOW_COVERAGE instead of 'absent' when coverage is below threshold, rejects candidate overreach with REFUSED OVERREACH, correctly returns empty impact sets for unread tables, detects dangling table references in entity claims/metadata with status unknown and DANGLING_TABLE, and strictly enforces project isolation. All changes remain strictly within allowed_files bounds for S1 (eso/graph/**) and S2 (qc/eso-graph-*.test.mjs). 0 critical, 0 minor findings.
